authority_conflict.POWO_WCVP: var. songarica is a synonym of accepted species B. ischaemum
authority_conflict.ITIS: var. songarica is separately listed as accepted variety (TSN 526948)
authority_conflict.primary_paper: Celarier & Harlan 1958 described two morphologically and cytologically differentiated types of B. ischaemum
authority_conflict.project_rule: Use POWO/WCVP species-level canonical name; preserve rank-specific labels and source concept without elevating taxonomic rank or changing cards.

hybrid_boundary.published_primary_evidence: Harlan 1963 documents natural introgression between B. ischaemum and historic B. intermedia in northern West Pakistan; 1966 work documents hybrid derivatives in the complex.
hybrid_boundary.interpretation: Complex-level historical hybridization is real; not proof that King Ranch accession or any current learner photo is a named hybrid or has particular parentage.

morphological_source_conflict_read_only.sources_disagree: Texas A&M King Ranch account says var. songarica nodes hairless; UT Austin Hays morphology and Celarier-Harlan-derived Tropical Forages descriptions report a short-hairy nodal ring.
morphological_source_conflict_read_only.action: Do not use glabrous vs pubescent node alone as a formal variety assignment or rewrite identification lessons in taxonomy lane.
